# Mitch Henderson {.home-name .unnumbered .unlisted}

::: home-lede
I use data and statistical models to answer practical questions in sport.
:::

I have a PhD in sports science and do data science work for NSW Health (state government health department). Whenever I can, I like to use statistical programming and modelling to solve sports problems.

Most posts include the data and code in both R and Python so you can reproduce them.
